verdict.rationale: Railway's own site states that every pull request gets its own preview, which is the core of this story. It also says public endpoints with SSL are live from the moment of deploy, implying each preview is reachable at a URL. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that each PR preview gets an automatic public URL, in-depth docs on setup and lifecycle (e.g. teardown on merge or close), and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond homepage marketing copy.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get an automatic preview URL for every pull request

citations.quote: Every pull request gets its own preview. No surprises after merge.
Connect your repo, Railway handles the rest. Auto-config, instant previews, no new tools to learn.
Private connections, public endpoints, SSL, and load balancing live from the moment you deploy.
